title.en: An Act Granting to Jesus Vao a Franchise to Install, Operate and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Calape, Province of Bohol, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to Jesus Vaño, for a period of thirty-five years from the approval of this Act,
the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power system
for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power, for sale within the limits of the
municipality of Calape, Province of Bohol, Philippine Islands: Provided, however, That any deposit made or
bond furnished by said Jesus Vaño in accordance with Act Numbered Thirty-five hundred and ten shall be
considered as a deposit made or bond furnished by him for the purposes of the present Act.
Act Numbered Thirty-five hundred and ten is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 4, 1934.
